title: China’s auto industry and global overcapacity
text:
Car industry is fascinating and difficult to understand the winners and losers!

The simple version: China built far more car factories than its own people will buy cars, so it’s dumping the extra cars on the rest of the world very cheaply.

title: Reflections on the Elizabeth Holmes movie
text:
We just saw The Elizabeth Holmes Movie — You Can See Everything (2026) in the theater (more people actively participating in a movie theater I have ever seen)!

My take: I couldn't quite figure out "who is zooming whom", who is lying or being duped, or who the joke is on.

title: AI, artificial intimacy, and human relationships
text:
AI, Artificial Intimacy, and the Future of Human Relationships

This is a summary of Ezra Klein’s conversation with MIT sociologist Sherry Turkle, author of Artificial Intimacy: Who We Become When We Talk to Machines.

I found Turkle to be way too pessimistic! I agree children are off limits, but adults will need to make their own decisions AND we will need long term data as to "outcomes."

title: Autonomous AI and the future of healthcare
text:
Trump administration Integrating AI into healthcare: what can go wrong?

My thinking involves comparing autonomous vehicles (Waymo, Zoox, Tesla Robotaxi) with "autonomous AI doctors".

There will be risks and mishaps during the deployment phase, but eventually, the benefits will far outweigh those risks.
